passages.text: That which enters into the mouth doesn’t defile the man; but that which proceeds out of the mouth, this defiles the man.
passages.note: Harmful words; what truly corrupts a person

passages.text: If the blind guide the blind, both will fall into a pit.
passages.note: Choosing whom to follow; bad guidance

passages.text: For what will it profit a man, if he gains the whole world, and forfeits his life? Or what will a man give in exchange for his life?
passages.note: Success and ambition at the cost of your soul

passages.text: For most certainly I tell you, if you have faith as a grain of mustard seed, you will tell this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move; and nothing will be impossible for you.
passages.note: Facing impossible obstacles; small faith, great results
